fusions.name: Rim Slam
fusions.desc: Slams the rim down around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Hurled Boss
fusions.desc: Hurls the shield for 28 damage, ignoring the target's armour, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Turned Aside
fusions.desc: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Banked Hide
fusions.desc: Conjures a guard: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 12% and by 4% more on the item, and 10% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it. It takes the element of the last enemy you struck.
